summary: Executed backend pytest regression (13 tests) and frontend Playwright integration flows on public preview URL. Core MVP research-only workflows are working; found one UI status inconsistency on offline agent detail page.

ui_bugs.issue: Offline agent detail always shows status badge 'Live' even when agent.status is offline; create button is disabled correctly, so label is misleading.

action_items: Fix AgentPage status badge to reflect actual agent.status (active/offline) instead of hardcoded Live label.
Add catch/error states to AgentPage and TaskPage Promise.all data fetching to avoid indefinite loading on API failure.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md when auth flows are introduced (file currently empty).
critical_code_review_comments: AgentPage hardcodes status UI as Live: Live, which contradicts backend state for offline agents.
Multiple frontend pages use Promise.all without catch (AgentPage, TaskPage), risking silent failures with no user feedback if one call rejects.
Widespread // @ts-nocheck disables type-safety on critical route/page files; raises regression risk for future integrations.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing seeded catalog and test-created task drafts only.
test_credentials: File checked before auth testing: /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL validated: https://agent-marketplace-131.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend pytest passed fully (13/13). Frontend routes tested with no console errors: /, /compare, /agents/yield-scout, /tasks/{created-id}. Verified compare cap 3, readiness flags, quote safeguards, wallet options MetaMask+Binance. MOCKED integrations observed as expected: seeded ERC-8004 catalog, PancakeSwap reference snapshot (read-only), MongoDB fallback for artifacts while endpoints/storage unavailable.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open /agents/signal-desk (offline seed), observe [data-testid='agent-detail-status'] renders 'Live' while [data-testid='create-task-button'] is disabled due to offline status. RCA: AgentPage.tsx line with status badge is hardcoded (text/class) and does not bind to agent.status. Mitigation: conditionally render badge text/class from agent.status and include offline visual state parity with AgentCard.
